item.description:
Kipowi 0.5.2

  • New Layout: put a picture beside others in side by side, stacked, three up, grid or feature layouts, then export it as one JPEG or PNG.
  • Add pictures to a layout by dropping, clicking or pasting (⌘V) — copied images and copied files both work.
  • Drag a picture to reframe it in its frame, and pinch to scale it. Double-click to reset.
  • Brightness, contrast and Remove Background apply to the selected picture in a layout.
  • Opening a numbered camera photo, such as IMG_0242, now offers “Only this image” instead of importing the whole folder as a sequence.
